What it is: Rapid paired montage for a custom/made-to-order product: opens on a caption like 'the stones our clients chose vs the rings we made', then alternates 'the stone' / 'the inspiration' shots with the finished piece made from it, and closes on 'design yours' with the brand logo.

Why it works: Each pair is a mini reveal that proves craftsmanship and makes the viewer imagine their own version; ideal for personalised/custom products (custom jewellery, pet portraits, photo gifts, engraved items).

How to make one: 1) Collect 4-8 pairs of customer input (photo, stone, sketch, inspiration image) and the finished product made from it. 2) Cut them as quick labelled pairs ('the photo' / 'the portrait') over trending music, close-up and hand-held. 3) End on a line like 'Send us yours / design your own' with the logo and offer.

Closest format already on the board: Product Comparison Video - that compares against a competitor or old method; here each pair is the customer's raw input next to the custom piece made from it.

What it is: A first-person 'I looked into it' story told almost entirely through phone screens: opens on a call screen or Google search ('I called my water company' / 'does legal water mean safe'), moves through real-looking web pages, databases, stats and a review card as evidence, then reveals the product as the fix with a before/after number and closes on the offer.

Why it works: Screen evidence feels like the viewer's own research, so the problem reads as discovered fact rather than an ad claim; great for invisible-problem products.

How to make one: 1) Write the investigation as 5-7 'then I found...' beats tied to a hidden problem your product fixes. 2) Screen-record each step (call screen, Google search typing, a stat page, a lookup tool, a review) with one caption per beat. 3) Finish with the product shown solving it (number before > after) and an offer card.

Closest format already on the board: Breakdown / Explainer - this is not a talking-head explanation; the whole ad is phone screen recordings acting as personal investigation evidence.
